description: Use before sending a page task's message. Says whether this workspace or another Parse workspace wrote to the task's page, its recipient or its site in the last 30 days, from the messages members marked sent and the emails Parse sent: a verdict (clear, site, others_wrote, you_wrote, wait), canPitch, one plain sentence, and the day each side last wrote. Another workspace is never named and nothing it wrote is shown. Read-only. Next: when canPitch is false, tell the user and skip the task for now.

brandSlug.description: The brand's slug or its name. Omit it to use the workspace's own brand.

id.description: A task id exactly as parse_next_tasks returned it.
